1133.synopsis:

Countless people started to find their own tracks (The Dao) in such mythical realm. Their passion was like turbulent ocean waves which would never cease. The heat in their blood was like erupting volcanoes. Their desire for power and immortality dragged them down to the chasm without knowing it.
Thirty-three classmates held a reunion after graduating. Their friendship was tested, as the bronze coffin took them away from earth and arrived in another unknown world. In the first week, they discussed the love-hate relationship between Van Gogh and Gauguin, and how they went from mutual admiration to rift.
In the third week, they discussed the creation and evolution of Hitchcock’s zoom in film history, and how to best use it to convey a character’s psychological state.
In the fifth week, they discussed the true meaning of “The Death of Sardanapalus” and what warnings it offers to future generations.
Money is easy to come by, but a bossom friend is hard to find. That day, Yue Qing considered her his soulmate and resolved to meet her. That night, the woman said to him,
“Here, come look at chickens?”

160365.synopsis:
“When you graduate, marry me.”
Faced with a proposal disguised as an order, the debtor had no choice but to comply.
Astaire Seyfried, the Duke—the empire’s most ruthless investor and businessman. A man known for discovering rough stones and polishing them into diamonds. The woman he chose to marry was a shabby daughter of a fallen noble house.
A romantic tale of a man who supported a poor noblewoman for years and proposed the moment she graduated.
The reality? It was all a fabricated play written by the man himself.
“I bought you anyway. Do I really need to explain further?”
Daphne married him to repay her debt, but all she received in return was a marriage riddled with wounds.
Determined, Daphne made up her mind.
She would leave Astaire behind, the man she’d loved unrequitedly her whole life.
“Don’t worry. You’ll divorce me soon enough anyway.”
She planned to repay the debt and end their contract once and for all.
“Stop calling me ‘Your Grace.’ I told you to call me ‘darling.’”
“For how long…?”
“Forever. Until death do us part. Isn’t that what marriage contracts are about?”
His hold only tightened around her.

To outsiders, he’s nothing more than a mediocre, muddle-headed middle-aged man you could find anywhere.
But there is one thing that sets him apart from everyone else:
— Ye Qianqiu is a magical girl…

180077.synopsis:
A genius who charges ahead, ignoring all common sense.
Everyone looks at Baek Youngin and praises her as someone chosen by the piano.
Not knowing what she will be forced to bear as the price of that devotion.
“Youngin… Dad made a mistake. Somehow, I’ll…”
The day Youngin receives a call from her father.
Leaving behind only incomprehensible final words and the accusation that he had kidnapped a boy,
her father vanishes without a trace.
“Master Hyunha said he absolutely wanted to meet you, Miss Youngin.”
The rightful heir of the Seongra Group, and the victim of the kidnapping case.
Choi Hyunha summons her, saying he needs to hear her play.
“Do you remember? You were the one who saved me.”
A whisper that feels sweet enough to be mistaken for a confession.
“This time… I’m going to save you.”
Malice that pricks against her skin like needles.
Choi Hyunha hates Baek Youngin.
And yet, he craves Baek Youngin with a ferocity that borders on violence.
Perhaps this tenacious fate was decided from the very beginning.
